item.title: Hospital to host blood drive
item.description: SSM Health St. Clare Hospital-Baraboo, will host a community blood drive from 1:30-5:30 p.m. Tuesday, March 3 in the Ringling Room’s basement level, 707 14th St., Baraboo.
